statement.zh: **人物**：吉尔伯特·弗纳姆（Gilbert Vernam）。本行是人物行，其原理对应贡献而非算法叙述。Shannon 的 1949 年论文第 1417 行印出「This type of perfect secrecy is realized by the Vernam system.」，把该类型完美保密的实现归到以 Vernam 命名的系统。因此该条目目把弗纳姆定位为这一系统的命名者与发现者，不把完美保密的证明归给他；一次性密码本的机制与完美保密定理由 one-time-pad、perfect-secrecy、shannon-perfect-secrecy 行承载。
statement.en: **Person**: Gilbert Vernam.It is registered under OTP and stream ciphers.

statement.zh: 其系统的设计条件与变体边界由 Shannon 印出。第 3081 行说「If the size of the key is not limited the Vernam system can be used.」，即密钥长度不受限制时可以使用该系统；第 2324 行说「running key ciphers can usually be solved uniquely」，并把 running key cipher 定义为把随机字母序列换成有意义文本的 Vernam type system。该条目目只主张这些印出的条件与变体关系，不把 running key 变体等同于一次性密码本，也不把密钥不受限制外推为工程上可无限扩展。
statement.en: It is listed because it connects concrete records, objects or procedures in OTP and stream ciphers, not because of its name.

statement.zh: 其系统在后世的用途由 HAC 第 2624 行印出：「used extensively by Russian agents operating in foreign countries」。该条目目只说这一印出的使用事实，不把特工使用读成弗纳姆本人的部署，也不推断具体年代或行动。
statement.en: Fix the object and its aliases; list the sourced dates, roles, parameters or inscriptions; state the observable output; then test the boundary.Any step without a source stops there rather than being filled with prose.

statement.zh: 边界由 HAC 印出：第 2615–2616 行说 Moscow-Washington hot-line 不再「secured with a one-time pad, which has been replaced by a symmetric-key cipher」。该条目目只说实际部署被更短密钥的对称密码替换，不称 Vernam system 已被攻破；running key 变体的可解性由 Shannon 论文的 why 节承载，不在本行展开。
statement.en: The boundary separates a sourced fact, a model-derived relation and an unverified gap.Secondary summaries yield to primary material; unsourced dates, counts and device values stay blank.

statement.zh:
可断代的坐标由 HAC 第 2612–2613 行印出：「Kahn [648] gives 1917 as the date when Vernam discovered the cipher」与「Vernam did not publish the result until 1926 [1222]」。因此该条目目把发现断到 1917 年、发表断到 1926 年；HAC 未印出生卒年，故不写。**可核角色与证据链**

吉尔伯特·弗纳姆归入OTP 与流密码，登记时代为第一次世界大战。本条目只登记有来源支持的教育/任职机构、公开文本或专利、参与的标准/机器/事件与可核同行评价。来源账本包括：Wikipedia search entry for 吉尔伯特·弗纳姆；MacTutor History of Mathematics Archive, University of St Andrews。
statement.en: Registered period: World War I.The exact date is left to the ledger; institutional placement and technical detail follow the cited sources.
